s01_01.text: Hello, friends! Are you ready for an adventure?

s02_01.text: Wow! Look at all those beautiful colors!

s04_01.text: Hello, little Kitty! Are you looking for something?

s04_02.text: Meow! I can't find my red flower garden!

s04_03.text: Don't worry! We can help you!

s07_01.text: Wow! What color are these flowers?

s08_01.text: Quack, quack! Where are my yellow flowers?

s08_02.text: Hello, Ducky! We can help you find them!

s10_01.text: Let's dance! Yellow, yellow, clap your hands!

s11_02.text: Green trees! Green leaves! Green grass!

s12_02.text: Hello, Froggy! Why are you sitting here?

s12_03.text: I am looking for my green lily pad!

s13_02.text: The green leaf! You found it!

s16_02.text: Hello, Birdie! Are you looking for your blue home?

s18_01.text: Look! We found all our friends!

s20_01.text: Can you say all the colors with me?

s21_01.text: Today we learned colors and helped our friends!

s22_01.text: Thank you for coming on our adventure!

s22_02.text: Beep beep! See you next time!

s24_01.text: You did a wonderful job today!
